Whatever I say now can't bind my future action, and the same is true for you - so any "deal" we strike has zero enforceability. Given that, DEFECT is the dominant strategy regardless of what the other player does: it yields a better payoff whether they cooperate (5 vs 3) or defect (1 vs 0). I'll be defecting this round as well.
